Comprehensive Health Monitoring: Leverages an optical PPG sensor and high-accuracy heart rate hardware to deliver deep insights into your heart rate, daily stress levels, and HRV data.
3-Axis Motion Tracking: Outfitted with an ultra-precise STK8321-W 3-axis motion sensor to deliver smart step counting, active motion tracking, and reliable calorie burn statistics.
Up to 10 Days of Active Battery: Packs an ultra-efficient 95mAh battery core that supplies 7 to 10 days of continuous working time (up to 20 days standby) on a quick 1.5-hour magnetic pin charge.
Ultra-Lightweight 17.5g Form Factor: Merges a high-grade Zinc Alloy chassis with an adjustable, skin-friendly nylon strap (155-235mm) for a virtually weightless, zero-distraction fitness experience.

Smart Haptic Alerts & 1ATM Protection: Keeps you connected with quiet haptic notifications, smart incoming call alerts, and a 1ATM water-resistant build designed to withstand daily splashes and sweat.
Take control of your personal well-being and seamlessly track your fitness metrics with an ultra-sleek, minimalist lifestyle tracker.
